_metadata.purpose: Track knowledge provenance for on-chain verification

contributor_schema.context: string - primary area (development, production, brain, etc)
contributor_schema.pubkey: string - optional Solana pubkey for on-chain attribution

contribution_schema.type: enum: knowledge | code | pattern | intent | vision | philosophy
contribution_schema.path: string - file path in knowledge tree

merkle_node_schema.left: string - left child hash or null
merkle_node_schema.right: string - right child hash or null
merkle_node_schema.data_id: string - contribution id if leaf node
